name: Rickshaw Painter
what: A colour-shooter puzzle game where paint tins ride a rail around a Bangladeshi rickshaw-art panel and the player paints the picture square by square.
hard_part: Levels are generated and proven solvable by code rather than hand-designed: a JavaScript engine with generator, solver and difficulty probe was ported bit-exact to Dart, and tests check engine parity and that every one of the first 60 levels is solvable with exact paint.
facts: 9 hand-drawn panels, then endless generated rickshaw motifs
Boards grow from 8×7 to 17×17, colours from 2 to 6
Finished panels share as a 1080×1080 framed image
